tldr: 台股9月8日收跌220點至47,105點，台積電逆勢收漲10元至2,470元。
台積電攜手ASML推進12吋High-NA EUV光罩，鎖定2033年先進製程量產。
壽險業2026年正式接軌IFRS 17與ICS 2.0，9月同步有5檔新基金（含2檔主動式ETF）開募。

items.title_zh: 台股收跌220點 台積電逆勢守穩
items.title_en: TAIEX ends 220 points lower as TSMC bucks the trend
items.summary_zh: 台股9月8日收盤下跌220.49點、跌幅0.47%，終場收在47,105.78點，成交量約8,766億元，盤面開高後震盪走低。權值王台積電逆勢上漲10元、收2,470元，為電子股回檔提供緩衝，指數跌幅得以收斂。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index fell 220.49 points, or 0.47%, on Sept 8 to close at 47,105.78, with turnover of about NT$877 billion as the market opened higher then drifted down. Weighting heavyweight TSMC defied the slide, adding NT$10 to finish at NT$2,470, cushioning a broader pullback in electronics.

items.title_zh: 外資回補 AI 伺服器 ODM 族群
items.title_en: Foreign funds rotate back into AI-server ODMs
items.summary_zh: 以鴻海為首的「老AI」伺服器代工族群獲外資回補，三大法人連日加碼相關權值股。此波輪動反映AI伺服器訂單能見度提升與晶片報價轉強，即便大盤走弱，仍支撐族群買氣。
items.summary_en: So-called "legacy AI" server assemblers led by Hon Hai drew renewed foreign buying, with institutional investors adding to positions in bellwether large-caps over consecutive sessions. The rotation reflects rising visibility for AI-server orders and firmer chip pricing, supporting sentiment even as the wider index eased.

items.title_zh: 台積電攜手 ASML 推 12 吋 High-NA EUV 光罩
items.title_en: TSMC and ASML push 12-inch High-NA EUV photomasks
items.summary_zh: 台積電與ASML於9月8日宣布，共同推動半導體由現行6吋光罩轉向12吋大尺寸光罩，以發揮High-NA EUV微影價值。大尺寸可消除兩張6吋光罩拼接限制、提升晶圓廠產能並降低成本；台積電規劃2030年於先進製程導入，力拚2033年量產。
items.summary_en: On Sept 8 TSMC and ASML announced a joint drive to shift the industry from today's 6-inch masks to 12-inch masks to unlock High-NA EUV lithography. The larger format removes the current two-mask stitching limit, lifting fab productivity and lowering cost; TSMC aims to adopt it in advanced nodes from 2030 and reach volume around 2033.

items.title_zh: 廣達 AI 伺服器訂單能見度延伸至 2027 年
items.title_en: Quanta sees AI-server orders visible into 2027
items.summary_zh: 廣達表示AI伺服器訂單能見度已延伸至2027年，並提前布局2028年產能，預估營收持續成長。除GB300持續出貨外，新一代Vera Rubin AI伺服器本季逐步進入量產、年底前開始貢獻營收，凸顯台廠ODM供應鏈需求續強。
items.summary_en: Quanta says AI-server order visibility now extends into 2027 with capacity planning already reaching 2028, projecting continued revenue growth. Beyond ongoing GB300 shipments, its next-generation Vera Rubin AI servers are set to ramp this quarter and contribute revenue by year-end, underscoring resilient demand across Taiwan's ODM supply chain.

items.title_zh: 壽險業 2026 年接軌 IFRS 17 與 ICS 2.0
items.title_en: Life insurers adopt IFRS 17 and ICS 2.0 in 2026
items.summary_zh: 台灣壽險業2025年開帳、2026年正式接軌IFRS 17，並同步導入ICS 2.0。金管會修正保險業財務報告編製準則，增訂「保險服務結果對稅前純益比率」等指標，使2026年年報更能反映實質獲利，並降低利率變動對淨值的衝擊。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's insurers open their books under IFRS 17 in 2025 and formally adopt the standard, alongside ICS 2.0, in 2026. The FSC has revised the industry's financial-reporting rules—adding metrics such as the insurance-service-result-to-pretax-profit ratio—so that 2026 annual reports better reflect underlying profitability and reduce distortions from interest-rate swings on net worth.

items.title_zh: 中國擬對銀行與保險業注資逾 500 億美元
items.title_en: Beijing to inject over US$50bn into banks and insurers
items.summary_zh: 據報導，中國計劃向銀行與保險公司注資逾500億美元以充實資本、支撐增長，顯示決策層倚重金融體系緩衝經濟放緩。此舉代表官方持續為金融機構背書，對區域銀行與保險同業具連動意義。
items.summary_en: Reports say China plans to inject more than US$50 billion into banks and insurance companies to shore up capital and support growth, as policymakers lean on the financial sector to cushion a slowing economy. The move signals continued state backstopping of financial institutions and has implications for regional lenders and insurers.

items.title_zh: 9 月 5 檔新基金開募 含 2 檔主動式 ETF
items.title_en: Five new funds launch in September, including two active ETFs
items.summary_zh: 9月共有5檔新基金接力開募，其中2檔主動式ETF為鎖定台股核心大型股的主動群益核心50（00415A）與聚焦台、韓、日半導體的主動安聯亞半導體（00412A），另有街口特選優息非投等債ETF（00992B）及兩檔多重資產基金。募集潮反映投資人對包裝化、收益與主題型商品的需求延續。
items.summary_en: Five new funds go on sale in September, among them two active ETFs: Capital Core 50 (00415A), tracking Taiwan's core large-caps, and Allianz Asia Semiconductor (00412A), focused on Taiwan, Korea and Japan chipmakers, plus JKO's high-yield non-investment-grade bond ETF (00992B) and two multi-asset funds. The pipeline shows sustained investor appetite for packaged, income- and theme-oriented products.

items.title_zh: 台灣主動式 ETF 掛牌達 40 檔
items.title_en: Active ETF listings in Taiwan reach 40
items.summary_zh: 自2025年開放主動式ETF以來，掛牌檔數已增至40檔，其中主動台股ETF達22檔最受歡迎，主動海外股與債券ETF分別有10檔、8檔。快速擴張為財富管理客戶提供更多元的專業主動、可交易策略，便於核心與衛星配置。
items.summary_en: Since Taiwan opened active ETF investing in 2025, listings have proliferated to 40, led by 22 active Taiwan-equity ETFs, with 10 overseas-equity and 8 bond active ETFs. The rapid build-out gives wealth clients a broader menu of professionally managed, exchange-traded strategies for core and satellite allocation.
